observations: body: the rules of the frame are printed heavy outside and thin inside; set as in the other tables. The print is slightly skewed (the rules lean about 0.7 pt over the height of the table).

figure: «اكتوبر» is printed with the tā' as a small stroke over the join of kāf and wāw; «المطرّح» with shadda and fatḥa; the Latin of the head of the last two columns is printed «[qu» at the end of its third line (for «[qui»), and its hyphens as raised dots.
body L7, L8: a mark is printed after the 6 of Iunius (L7) and a dot after the 2 of September (L8); not transcribed.
body L11: the 8 of «280» is printed broken.
body L17: a mark is printed over the 5 of Iunius; not transcribed.
body L23: the 2 of «1428» is printed broken.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
